## Problem

What's missing, or what's currently awkward? Describe the situation
this would improve, not just the solution.

## Proposed Solution

What you'd like to see happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why you didn't prefer them.

## Scope Check

- [ ] I've checked `README.md`'s "Version 1 Scope" section - this
      isn't already explicitly out of scope.
- [ ] I've checked `KNOWN_ISSUES.md` - this isn't already tracked as
      deferred work.

## Additional Context

Anything else - mockups, related issues, etc.
